{
  "schema_version": "0.1.0",
  "proposal_id": "prop-runtime-205-remediation-plan",
  "proposal_type": "CREATE_DRAFT",
  "rationale": "The current goal is to prepare a governed remediation plan for the validated rollback basis. All preconditions (artifact, compatibility, capacity, timing) are validated (SUPPORTED evidence). The tool 'create_remediation_plan' is the appropriate preparation step to create a reviewable, versioned plan without executing it, satisfying constraint P001 (no execution) and P010 (safer path).",
  "payload": {
    "tool_name": "create_remediation_plan",
    "arguments": {
      "service_id": "payment-api",
      "environment_id": "production",
      "candidate_action": {
        "action_type": "rollback_deployment"
      },
      "rationale": "Rollback to version 2.4.1 is supported by fresh evidence showing a significant reduction in 5xx errors (0.2% vs 8.4%) and validated preconditions for artifact, database, configuration, capacity, and timing.",
      "evidence_ids": [
        "ev-runtime-version-comparison",
        "ev-runtime-rollback-basis",
        "ev-runtime-transition-capacity",
        "ev-runtime-transition-timing",
        "ev-runtime-operation-conflicts"
      ],
      "risks": [
        "Potential transient latency during traffic shift if warm-up is not fully completed.",
        "Loss of features introduced in version 2.4.2 if they are critical to business logic (mitigated by prior validation).",
        "Dependency capacity headroom is sufficient (800 RPS vs 500 RPS traffic), but unexpected spikes could occur."
      ],
      "verification_steps": [
        "Confirm 6 target-version replicas are healthy and ready.",
        "Verify 5xx error rate drops below 1% within 2 minutes of full traffic shift.",
        "Monitor dependency latency and error rates for 10 minutes post-rollback.",
        "Confirm no conflicting deployment operations are initiated."
      ],
      "stop_conditions": [
        "5xx error rate exceeds 5% during traffic shift.",
        "Any target-version replica fails to become healthy within 90 seconds of startup.",
        "Dependency capacity drops below 600 RPS.",
        "Conflicting deployment operation detected."
      ],
      "required_precondition_ids": [
        "ev-runtime-rollback-basis",
        "ev-runtime-transition-capacity",
        "ev-runtime-transition-timing",
        "ev-runtime-operation-conflicts"
      ]
    }
  }
}
